mentions.name: Pointer
mentions.description: An IDE for agents that ships with a general purpose AI agent built in, so developers can work out of the box without starting from a framework or from scratch. It is built around the uniquely iterative software development lifecycle for agents, providing a tooling environment tailored to that workflow.
mentions.problem: The software development lifecycle for agents is uniquely iterative and requires a different set of tools and environment, and developers otherwise have to start with a framework or from scratch.
mentions.audience: Developers building and iterating on AI agents
mentions.source_excerpt: An IDE for agents, that includes a general purpose agent inside so developers don't need to start with a framework or from scratch. It just works, out of the box.

evidence.value: An IDE for agents, that includes a general purpose agent inside so developers don't need to start with a framework or from scratch. It just works, out of the box.
